image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a pedestrian traffic signal head. The housing is dark and curved with a large visor. Inside, an LED matrix displays a 'Walk' symbol (a walking person) composed of yellow/green LEDs, with a red 'Don't Walk' hand symbol partially visible to the left. The background is dark and indistinct, likely a building facade or night sky.

The boundary between the dark housing and the visor interior is slightly soft and ill-defined, suggesting minor geometric inconsistency in the 3D model generation.
The curvature of the signal face seems slightly inconsistent with the angle of the visor, creating a subtle spatial dissonance, though it could be attributed to wide-angle lens distortion.
